mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over 3 consecutive months indicates the Federal Reserve is shifting from tightening to easing, lowering discount rates and boosting equity valuation multiples, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 5% signals a tightening cycle, raising discount rates and compressing equity valuations, which produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) above 200,000 jobs indicates a strengthening labor market, prompting firms to expand capital spending and boost earnings momentum, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in strong-labor periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in monthly employment growth below -100,000 jobs signals a labor market contraction, prompting firms to cut investment and earnings growth, which produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in weak-labor periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105 over 3 consecutive months indicates weakening domestic demand, which compresses corporate earnings and equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in weak-demand periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in industrial production (INDPRO) above 110 over 3 consecutive months indicates strengthening domestic supply capacity, which boosts corporate earnings and equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in strong-supply periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the CPIAUCSL inflation index below 2% over 3 consecutive months signals disinflation, prompting the Fed to hold rates steady and reducing discount rates, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in disinflation periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment (UNRATE) above 4.5% indicates a labor market softening, prompting firms to reduce investment and earnings growth, which produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in weak-labor periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
